Gutama Girja Urago is a young agricultural economist who enjoys playing with R and has a keen interest in quantitative analysis without leaving qualitative aside. Currently, he is pursuing the Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters Degree organized by six European Universities hosting at Ghent University.

## Education

International Master of Science in Rural Development | Ghent University, Belgium |  Sept 2022 - Sep 2024

Master of Science in Agricultural Economics | Ondokuz Mayis University, Turkey | Sept 2020 - July 2022

Bachelor of Science in Agricultural Economics | Haramaya University, Ethiopia | Sept 2015 - July 2018


## Experience

Graduate Teaching Assistant | Haramaya University | August 2018 - September 2019
